title: Which way will Israel break? Netanyahu still in it after election night surprises

title: China keeps a close eye on US midterm shake-up
summary: The US midterm elections have resulted in the Democratic Party taking control of both chambers of the US Congress, leaving Donald Trump as a lame duck president for the remainder of his term. title: Pope Leo embarks on Latin America trip with a first stop in Uruguay

title: California governor to grant clemency to all 548 death row inmates in state

title: The women who rode the blue wave
summary: In this edition, we report on how the US midterms, which saw the Democrats make massive gains, also marked a series of historic firsts for women. Plus how an impoverished neighbourhood in El Salvador, once a no-go zone plagued by gang violence, is being transformed by women into a vibrant canvas for street art.

title: 'Too early to draw conclusions' as bomb threat hoaxes target European countries
summary: Several Irish media outlets reported receiving bomb threats on Friday as a wave of hoax alerts that had so far mainly targeted airlines continued across Europe, with more than a dozen new flights affected. title: Paraguay's Peña offers resignation amid banking scandal, protests
